source: Wikidata for Korean esports players and the game each competes in; Wikimedia Pageviews API, four Southeast Asian editions summed, calendar year 2025
unit: People. One row is one player, counted under their first listed game.
question: We called it an esports pattern. Splitting by game shows it was one game.
narrowsAnEarlierClaim: An earlier piece of ours said Korean esports players in these editions peak in a single month. Split by game, almost every one of them turns out to play the same game, so the honest version is narrower: it is a League of Legends pattern, and we could not test whether it holds for any other title.
whyOtherGamesCannotBeTested: It is not that other games were checked and found different. There were not enough readers to check. Korea has more StarCraft II players on Wikidata than League of Legends players, and four of them have an article in these four editions.
cannotAnswer: Wikidata lists a game for some players and not others, and a player who competed in two is counted under the first. This is a floor on how many play each game.
howWeFoundTheGame: Wikidata records the game in P2416, not in P641. P641 says "esports" for 1,263 of the 1,266 Korean players, which is true and useless. We spent a run finding that out.
